title: Context and object authority
summary: TemplateContext owns named render inputs. Directory traversal is explicit. Ordinary objects are visible only through TemplateObjectView, where application code maps public template property names to allowlisted zero-argument messages.
boundaries: Template text never discovers arbitrary object methods.
TemplateObjectView is an application-created projection, not reflection.
put and putObject reject blank context names.
Resolving a missing path fails closed unless the selected render policy explicitly keeps the original placeholder.
